finalText:
All 4 pass.

Root cause: `processOrder` (`src/jobs/processOrder.js`) skip try/finally — comment say it "used to need connection held across retry loop" but release stayed unguarded after that loop remove. Bad order throw, `pool.release` never run, connection stuck in `inUse` forever. `handleRequest`/`withConnection` path fine already, only worker job path leak. Under 2am failure spike, worker pool drain to zero, exhaustion cascade.

Fix: wrap run in try/finally, release always. Tests now green.
